caption: The drawing depicts a needlepoint pattern of a dog standing on a patch of ground. The dog is mainly white with black and brown spots and details, and it has a black patch over its ear and eye. Its open mouth is depicted with a red tongue, and a red collar is visible around its neck. The dog is positioned facing left, with its tail raised high and fluffy. There is a bouquet of multicolored flowers, incorporating green, blue, pink, and red, placed on its back, with green foliage visible among the flowers. The ground under the dog is represented in shades of brown and green. The background of the entire pattern consists of a solid, grid-patterned pink area. The pattern is framed by a plain, off-white border.
title: Chair Cover
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
